notes: unit_min_percent moved DOWN this commit, 63.26 -> 63.05. Cause: read_notes() gained the generated-note skip (two statements plus a branch), and read_notes is exercised only by the integration test that needs a real collection — so those lines count against the unit measurement while never being reachable by it. The predicate they call, is_generated(), IS unit-tested directly. full_min_percent rose 70.20 -> 70.29 in the same commit, which is the same change measured where it can actually run. Recorded because the policy requires a lowered floor to say why. Raise only via `python scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same commit that earns the increase, never by hand.
